query: SELECT workspace_id,id FROM invoice_deliveries WHERE (status IN ('running','sending') OR (status='unknown' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_send_logs l WHERE l.workspace_id=invoice_deliveries.workspace_id AND l.id=invoice_deliveries.send_log_id AND l.status IN ('accepted','blocked')))) AND started_at<now()-interval '10 minutes' ORDER BY started_at LIMIT 100
